title: 蔡崇信：AI将创造50万亿经济，阿里决心调整资本支出
speaker: Joe Tsai

segments.en: He spoke exclusively to us at the Viva Tech Bloomberg Awards in Paris recognizing the companies, founders and leaders shaping the future of technology.
segments.zh: 他在巴黎Viva Tech彭博奖上独家接受我们采访，该奖项表彰塑造技术未来的公司、创始人和领导者。

segments.en: We always say when the world changes you have to change. You have to change yourself.
segments.zh: 我们常说，当世界改变时，你必须改变。你必须改变自己。

segments.en: We saw this coming especially with the we're in the era of transformer models and generative AI.
segments.zh: 我们预见到了这一点，尤其是在Transformer模型和生成式AI的时代。

segments.en: We felt that this was definitely the direction but it requires a lot of will, a lot of capital to be invested.
segments.zh: 我们觉得这绝对是方向，但需要很大的决心和大量资本投入。

segments.en: In order to do that and turn things around toward those pretty heavy cat-packs investments you really have to have the will to do it and we did.
segments.zh: 为了做到这一点，转向那些相当重的资本支出，你真的需要有决心去做，我们做到了。

segments.en: We decided that this was going to be the future and I've said this earlier today AI is not just about a technology that is going after the IT budget or the software budget of enterprises.
segments.zh: 我们决定这就是未来，我今天早些时候说过，AI不仅仅是追逐企业IT预算或软件预算的技术。

segments.en: It's going to be a $50 trillion economy and the company has the will to shift its capital expenditure plans accordingly.
segments.zh: 它将创造50万亿美元的经济，公司有意愿相应调整资本支出计划。

segments.en: We decided that this was going to be the future and I've said this earlier today AI is not just about a technology that is going after the IT budget or the software budget of enterprises.
segments.zh: 我们决定这就是未来，我今天早些时候说过，AI不仅仅是追逐企业IT预算或软件预算的技术。
